digest.component_or_area: LLM provider inference and model resolution
propositions: infer_provider maps the gemini prefix to google_genai, but google_genai is not a member of _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or ProviderSession._builders, causing provider_factory to raise LLMConfigError at call time

model_classes._resolve_target composes a qualified provider string using infer_provider's result verbatim; when that result is google_genai, _pai_model returns it unchanged and provider construction fails
anthropic_model._pai_model has a private _PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX table that translates google_genai to google-gla, masking the defect for the bare model path but not for the model-class ladder path

pydantic-ai 1.107.1 recognizes google as the canonical provider name for the Gemini Developer API and includes google:gemini-* ids in its known_model_names(), whereas google-gla, google-vertex, and vertexai are deprecated and removed in v2.0

a bare gemini-* model id is currently unusable because it resolves to a provider name absent from all registries, leaving operators with plausible-looking configurations that fail only when a gate runs
